name: Run trace drawer shows the project-context block a seeded run sent
description: From PR #482, open the Agent runs tab, open the seeded run's trace drawer from the Timeline ('Open run trace & logs'), expand Prompt assembly (collapsed by default) and then the 'Project context — attached specs (untrusted)' row, and confirm the seeded document's text (docs/security-baseline.md, rule PX-7) is what the run sent. Covers R-58 (L05 Project Context). The run, its trace and the wrapped document are seeded by server/src/db/seed.ts (seedProjectContextRun) — no model call, and no step here starts a review. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).

steps.label: tall viewport: the drawer sections below Stats must be on screen, agent-browser does not scroll before a click
